title: Alert Concierge — On-call Transfer Narrative Strip (prototype)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: On-call engineers report context gaps during alert handoffs — missing cost implications, recent rollback/rollout history, and a simple next-action suggestion. Goal: Design a compact "Alert Concierge" narrative strip that surfaces concise SLO deltas, cost signal, recent rollouts, and an actionable handoff checklist (1-3 items) that can be embedded in the incident/alert panel and included in shift summaries. Scope: prototype micro-interaction, responsive layout for Console left rail + incident drawer, content taxonomy for SLO/cost/time data, and handoff copy templates. Out of scope: backend schema changes, full localization (deliver EN only).
comments: 2026-02-21 Maya Chen: Kickoff sync with PM + Eng. Agreed to keep strip < 160px height and prioritize scannability. PM asked for explicit cost delta and an optional 'cost severity' flag.
2026-02-24 Liam Patel: First Figma pass uploaded. Focused on three visual states: Normal, Degraded (SLO breach warning), and Recovered. Included hover for detailed cost breakdown.
2026-02-25 Helena Ortiz (PM): Feedback — add a lightweight link to the active runbook and an explicit 'follow-up' checkbox to reduce cognitive load during handoffs.

2026-02-27 Eng feedback (Sahil Rao): Kernel — want an immutable event token to snapshot which model/version produced the alert so the strip reads 'model pinned' when relevant. Also flagged potential perf risk of resolving cost metrics in real time; suggested precomputed deltas from metrics pipeline.

2026-02-28 Design review: Reduced visual weight of cost chip, added colorblind-safe iconography, and replaced long-form SLO graph with a sparkline + numeric delta. Also created copy alternatives for the 'next action' CTA: 'Acknowledge & Route' vs 'Assign to on-call'.

2026-03-01 QA notes (Design handoff): Need microcopy for 0-data states and a fallback when cost data is delayed; created two variants in Figma and marked 'Variant B' as preferred after accessibility pass.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype shows three visual states (Normal, Warning, Recovered) including SLO sparkline and numeric delta
On-call transfer view includes runbook link + one-click follow-up checkbox that persists to incident thread
Cost chip shows 24h delta and links to token-level cost breakdown modal
Design tokens and color usage meet WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for all states
Figma file annotated with QA notes and dev handoff specs (padding, z-index, responsive breakpoints)
PM sign-off on copy and fallback behavior for missing cost data
decisions: Keep strip single-line height with expandable details on hover/click to avoid increasing incident panel footprint
Show cost delta as relative percentage and absolute token USD estimate; detailed breakdown lives in a modal to reduce noise
SLO sparkline limited to last 6 hours in strip; full SLO chart links to SLO detail page
Use precomputed cost deltas from metrics pipeline to avoid live computation on render
next_steps: Address engineering note about immutable event token — add 'model: pinned' badge when present (Eng: Sahil Rao)
Finalize copy variants and push final Figma frames to the 'dev-ready' page
Create small engineering spike to validate cost delta latency (owners: Metrics team)
Schedule a 30-min handoff demo with on-call rotation team and include sampled incidents to test comprehension
Add keyboard accessibility states and document in dev handoff notes
